purpose: Source of truth for generating a React/TypeScript component library from Figma. Read-only extraction; no code generated.

source.method: Figma desktop MCP read tools (get_metadata, get_variable_defs, get_design_context, get_screenshot) for pages, components, node IDs and variable bindings; Figma native Variables export (4 files, revision 2) supplied by the user for collections, modes, variable IDs, aliases and scopes. No write tools succeeded; the one script attempt was refused for lack of edit access.
source.limits: Cloud Figma write-capable calls are not used; the file was only read. Text styles other than Body/Medium are not visible to the read tools and the Variables export does not include them.
source.revisionNotes: Revision 2: user fixed the Paragraph spelling, Alias/Information/50, Brand/Blue/200 and the default-secondary alias, then re-exported. Component variable bindings were re-read from the file on the same day. Re-read on 2026-09-20 after the user fixed border-width bindings: Buttons and Button_Icon read per variant; Form Inputs, Checkbox and Menu read at section level only, because the Figma rate limit ('try again tomorrow') blocked the remaining calls. Second re-read on 2026-09-21 through the cloud Figma connector signed in with the paid Full seat: structure of the Components page, and per-variant variable bindings for Field, Input, Label, Checkbox item and label, .menu item, Menu, scrollbar, Dropdown, Breadcrumb, Breadcrumb_items, Link and next, plus Button_Icon 15:902. Button and Button_Icon variants other than 15:902 were last read on 2026-09-20. Text styles read on 2026-09-21 from the user's specimen frame 70:170. Body/Small and Body/caption re-read on 2026-09-21 after the user's fixes.

pages.name: Tokens
pages.content: 8 columns x 11 color swatches (50 to 950) with step labels, plus 6 black background panels

collections.name: Brand
collections.role: Primitive layer: raw color ramps, foundation white/black, font families, numeric Scale. Aliases nothing.
collections.modeNote: One export file was provided per collection; Figma writes one file per mode, so each collection has a single mode.

collections.name: Alias
collections.role: Role layer: named color roles (Primary, Success, Error, Warning, Information, Neutral), font family roles, border width and border radius. Every variable aliases a Brand variable.
collections.modeNote: One export file was provided per collection; Figma writes one file per mode, so each collection has a single mode.

collections.name: Mapped
collections.role: Semantic layer consumed by components: Surface, Border, Text, Icon colors. Every variable aliases an Alias variable.
collections.modeNote: One export file was provided per collection; Figma writes one file per mode, so each collection has a single mode.

collections.name: Responsive
collections.role: Typography sizes: font size, line height and paragraph spacing for H1 to H6, Paragraph Large/Medium/Small, Caption. Raw numbers, no aliases.
collections.modeNote: One export file was provided per collection; Figma writes one file per mode, so each collection has a single mode.

tokens.collectionChain: Mapped (semantic) -> Alias (roles) -> Brand (primitives). Responsive stands alone. Every Mapped variable aliases an Alias variable.
tokens.variableSource: Figma native Variables export supplied by the user (Brand, Alias, Mapped, Responsive). Variable IDs, alias targets and scopes come from that export.

findings.text: Collections, modes and variable IDs come from the user's Variables export. 4 collections, 238 variables, one mode each (Mapped's only mode is named Light). No dark mode exists.

Variant property is named 'Property 1' on Button and Button_Icon, where it means interaction state (Default/Hover/Focus/Disabled). Label also names its variant property 'Property 1', but there it is unrelated to interaction state: Label has only one variant, 'Required', and the asterisk is actually driven by the separate 'required' boolean component property.

State value casing is inconsistent: Button uses Default/Hover/Focus/Disabled; Field, Checkbox item and .menu item use Default/hover/focus/disabled; Breadcrumb_items and Link use Default/Active/Disabled/focus.
Field Type=Default now uses Border/* tokens for border colors (Border/default, Border/action-hover, Border/disabled), matching Filled and Error.
Checkbox Selected variants contain no check glyph layer.
Checkbox label text now binds Text/Body.
Link text now binds Body/Medium (Paragraph Medium variables) on all four variants. Underline remains a text decoration.

Focus ring styles differ: Checkbox uses Border/action-hover at 2px with a 46px centered box; Button and Field use Border/focus with inset -3 (Transparent Button -2); Breadcrumb items and Link use a 1px Border/action ring at inset -2. Field Error focus uses Border/error.
Disabled Transparent Button and Button_Icon measure 141x42 and 42x42, two pixels larger than sibling variants.
Typo fixed: 'Paragraph Medium/...' now reads correctly on nodes and in the export.
.menu item has no focus state; Dropdown has no open/closed, hover, focus or disabled states; no loading, pressed or read-only states anywhere.
Code Connect maps some icons to Compose snippets (favorite, mail) and two to React 'icons' package components; IconArrowUpRight is passed size="48" on a 20px slot.
Alias chain is known: Mapped -> Alias -> Brand. Tokens page swatches are hard-coded alpha fills; after the Blue/200 fix all 88 effective colors match the Brand variables.
Node 18:589 'Chevron' is an empty rounded-rectangle in the Navigation section, not a component.
Alias/Information/50 now aliases Brand/Blue/50 (#EAECFB); Alias/Information/200 and Mapped/Surface/information follow (#A9B2EC and #EAECFB).
Brand/Blue/200 is now #A9B2EC, distinct from Blue/300 (#7E8BE3).
Mapped/Surface/default-secondary now aliases Alias/Foundation/White. All 44 Mapped variables alias Alias.

Border widths are bound to Alias tokens on Button, Button_Icon, Field, Input, .menu item, Menu, Dropdown, and the Link and Breadcrumb_items focus rings (all re-read 2026-09-21). Checkbox item Unselected Default (19:666) and Unselected hover (19:669) have no border-width variable by design, confirmed by the user.
Responsive collection has one mode, so no breakpoint values exist despite the name. Mapped has one mode (Light), so there is no dark theme.

Naming drift: Brand calls the neutral ramp Gray, Alias calls it Neutral; Brand/Purple/500 is named '500-Default' while other 500 steps are plain; Mapped uses Text/Body and Text/Caption (capitalized) beside Text/heading and Text/placeholder.

14 of 44 Mapped color variables are not used by any inspected component: Surface/page, success, warning, information; Border/success, warning, information; Text/heading, success, warning, information; Icon/success, warning, information. Mapped/Text/heading is now used by the heading text layers in the specimen frame 70:170, though still by no component.
Text styles read from the specimen frame 70:170: Heading/H1 to H6 (Roboto SemiBold), Body/Large, Body/Medium, Body/Small and Body/caption (Inter Regular).
The duplicate Checkbox item variant 53:782 no longer exists; the set has 8 variants.
Body/Small now exists and binds Paragraph Small (12/16, paragraph spacing 8) and Font Family/Body.

Body/caption now binds Caption/Font size and Caption/Line Height, and its name matches the layer. It still uses the literal font family 'Inter' instead of Font Family/Body, and the style does not bind Caption/Paragraph Spacing.

Text style names (Heading/H1, Body/Large, Body/Medium, Body/Small, Body/caption) differ from the Responsive variable groups they bind (H1, Paragraph Large, Paragraph Medium, Paragraph Small, Caption).
